observedWithoutFix.classification: The pre-start environment contained the bundled SDK, but the user's interactive zsh startup changed GOROOT and PATH afterward.

referenceArtifact.boundary: Static shipped-artifact identity and class presence only. Runtime equivalence and proprietary source reconstruction are not claimed.

implementation.environment: The selected SDK's Go bin, gopls/dlv tool directories and GOPATH/bin are prepended. Project GOROOT, GOFLAGS, GOOS, GOARCH, CGO_ENABLED and user environment entries are carried through shell startup using the Terminal plugin's documented force-set/force-prepend integration variables.
implementation.interactiveShell: The user's normal login shell and profile remain active.
implementation.fallback: If no local terminal widget shell is available, no external command is launched by this customizer.

processCleanup.result: Closing the active terminal requested confirmation; Terminate removed both the shell and foreground sleep process with no remaining matching process.

tests.assertions: Project SDK path precedes shell PATH; the shell PATH and shell variables remain present; GOROOT, GOPROXY, GOFLAGS, GOOS, GOARCH and CGO_ENABLED are force-set for shell integration.
tests.fullGate: 806/806 Kotlin tests, 147 reports, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped; buildPlugin, prepareSandbox and verifyPluginStructure passed.

evidenceBoundary: This verifies a local macOS interactive terminal and foreground child cleanup on one selected project SDK. Detached/background daemons, remote/WSL terminals, every shell/profile combination and Windows interactive terminal behavior remain separate checks.
